$comment: HUP-S11.0 installer size budgets (gate g5-size). Checked by scripts/size-budget.mjs; see release/README.md.
maxBytes: integer = gated (over budget exits 1); null = measured and reported, not gated (no baseline yet).
Artifact baselines are the shipped v0.4.2 GitHub release assets; maxBytes = baseline + about 5%, rounded.
Component baselines are a local v0.4.2 macOS aarch64 build (target/release/bundle, 2026-09-30); maxBytes = baseline + 10%, rounded up to the next MB.

2026-10-04 (HUP-S11.0, pending owner sign-off): the macOS rows a local 0.5.0-line bundle-lite build pushed over budget were re-set from that build: installer and updater = measured + about 5%, rounded up to the next 5 MB; components = measured + 10%, rounded up to the next MB. See release/README.md.

2026-10-04 (L14 release prep, pending owner sign-off): measuredBytes/measured record a re-measurement after the llama prune and the Hermes strip; maxBytes and baselineBytes (what each budget was set from) are unchanged. See release/README.md.
Raising a budget is a reviewed change: say why in the PR and update baselineBytes when a new release ships.
